newsitem.title: USA: FPA says to acquire Healthcap Inc.
newsitem.headline: FPA says to acquire Healthcap Inc.

text.p: FPA Medical Management Inc and Healthcap Inc said Friday they signed a definitive agreement for FPA to buy Healthcap in a stock-for-stock merger.
FPA said the merger would expand its services to Missouri and Nevada and is expected to increase its 1997 revenues on a pro forma basis to more than $1 billion.
The merger would be accounted for as a pooling of interests and is expected to close at the end of June, FPA said.
FPA said the merger will be immediately positive to earnings through the consolidation of corporate and market operating expenses.
An FPA spokesman said he could not immediately elaborate on details of the deal.
Healthcap provides services to more than 300,000 enrollees, FPA said.
